info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Market Order Execution API
info.description: The Market Order Execution API facilitates the retrieval of market order execution details within wholesale trading operations. This API is designed for financial institutions and trading platforms looking to access real-time data about market order executions, providing insights into transaction success, pricing, and execution times. Typical consumers include traders, financial analysts, and developers building trading applications. By leveraging this API, users can enhance their market responsiveness and decision-making processes.

get.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific market order execution identified by RES-100045. This endpoint allows users to review execution data for better trading insights and decision-making.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to execute a market order in the wholesale trading system. It should contain the necessary parameters that define the specifics of the order being requested.

200.description: Successfully retrieved details of the market order execution.
